## Design

### 2026-10-09 – Day 001 :-

**0.62h**

Day 001 :-
With inspiration from the Stabie project, I started my Figi project today. today I finished the schematic and also created the BOM, but I haven't added the PCB price yet.
 First, I should mention that I didn't know how to add symbols like 5V now I know how to do that, as well as how to connect components using labels without drawing lines across the schematic.
I made maximum use of the Stabie documentation, so it was successful. However, I have an issue with the Edge Cut. While trying to fix it today, I learned key points about layers and routing.

### 2026-10-09 – With inspiration from the Stabie project, I started my Figi project today.

**2h**

With inspiration from the Stabie project, I started my Figi project today.
 today I finished the schematic and also created the BOM, but I haven't added the PCB price yet.
 First, I should mention that I didn't know how to add symbols like 5V now I know how to do that, as well as how to connect components using labels without drawing lines across the schematic.

I made maximum use of the Stabie documentation, so it was successful. However, I have an issue with the Edge Cut. While trying to fix it today, I learned key points about layers and routing.
